newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling down on dlr, but should recover.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling down on dlr, but should recover.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling opened down about a shilling against the dollar on Thursday after nervous trading on Wednesday, but should recover on increased dollar inflows from foreign investors and agricultural exports, dealers said.
Against the dollar, the Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.31 from Wednesday's mean of 53.72 while against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean of 89.52 from 88.01.

"When the shilling takes a knock for a technical reason and not because of a political or economic reason like what happened yesterday, the market normally adjusts itself," a senior dealer told Reuters.
Another dealer said it appeared the shilling's losing streak against the dollar had been reversed.
"Importers have stepped out of the market, they found the prices too high," the dealer added.
The money market was liquid with overnight rates quoted at 8-9 percent unchanged.
